title: Per-role judgements (eval/judgements.json)
description: The scorer's per-role judgements for D1 (requirements match), D2 (proof of work) and D4 (org-specific edge), plus hard-requirement and eligibility calls. Keyed by role id from market/roles/latest.json.

judged_by.description: Which AI agent, and model when known, made these judgements, for example {"agent": "Claude Code", "model": "claude-opus-5-5"}. Different agents can judge the same evidence differently, so the result page and the dashboard show it.

extension.description: Extension field: any key starting x_ holds data the engine never reads (for example a field from an older system). Kept as is.

eligibility_blocked.description: Overrides the automatic blocker detection when set.

hard_eligibility_block.description: The role has an eligibility blocker the plan can never clear (for example a citizenship rule). The role is scored as blocked, and the projection keeps eligibility (D6) at 0.

location_class.description: Overrides the automatic location class when set.
